Do not assume the corner cell is background: a uniform border row or column can be a colored divider. Infer background from the field (for example, its dominant color), then identify full-line separators against it. A demo is useful only if its possible outcomes discriminate among live candidates. 5. After a correct verdict, save the verified transform at `programs/<task id>.py` and finish. Never claim an unverified file reproduces the examples.
